title: Glance Boost
description: Minecraft Game Optimization and Fps Boost!
body:
⚡ Glance Boost: Performance Refined
Glance Boost is a lightweight, high-performance modpack for Minecraft 1.21 designed to give you a massive FPS increase without changing the look of the game. Get more frames in just a glance.
🚀 Why choose Glance Boost?
Maximum FPS: Powered by the latest optimization engine (Sodium, Lithium, and more).
1.21 Ready: Fully updated to support the latest Minecraft features and technical changes.
Stutter-Free: Focused on reducing memory usage and smoothing out frame spikes.
Vanilla Friendly: No gameplay changes—just pure performance for survival, creative, or servers.
🛠️ Included Optimizations
Rendering: Optimized world rendering and chunk loading.
Logic: Enhanced game engine math to reduce CPU load.
Memory: Improved garbage collection and RAM management.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Features
No More Lag
It makes the game run faster, so you don’t get stuck or lag during gameplay.

Fixes Crashes
It helps prevent the game from crashing, giving you a better experience.

Works on Low-End Devices
Even if your device isn’t powerful, this modpack helps it run Minecraft without issues.

Easy to Use
You don’t need to be an expert. Just install the modpack, and you’re good to go!
